generation.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production sprite sheet for a web character animation.
Input image 1 is the exact character, art style, costume and seated silhouette reference. Generate a new animation sheet of THIS Artoria in her white Last Episode dress, matching the delicate anime linework, pale coloring, green eyes, blonde braided bun and ahoge.
Output: ONE image, 2048 x 1536 pixels, exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows, EIGHT equal 512 x 768 cells. Each cell contains one complete full-body seated drawing. Truly transparent alpha background, no checkerboard pattern, no colors behind her, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no borders.
This is a consecutive frame animation, not a collection of different poses. Frame order is left to right, top row then bottom row. Identical camera, body scale, seating position, skirt hem, foot position, face location and head orientation across all eight cells. Center every drawing consistently within its cell with clear padding. Her entire body, ahoge and dress must stay within the cell.
Keep the face and neck beautifully intact and naturally drawn in EVERY frame. NO head rotation, head bobbing, leaning, morphing or head-position changes. Movement comes only from the explicitly described gesture, drawn naturally. Preserve original facial identity and costume exactly. Other than the specified moving body parts, all pixels should remain visually consistent between frames. The last frame must return to the first frame's pose for a seamless loop.
Animation: A friendly hand wave. Keep her left hand resting on her lap. Her raised right forearm and wrist make a small graceful side-to-side wave with natural finger articulation. Frames: 1 original upright palm; 2 palm starting inward; 3 palm inward; 4 hand passing upright; 5 palm outward; 6 palm returning; 7 hand almost upright with a warm smile; 8 same as frame 1. Head stays completely still. The sleeve, elbow and wrist are redrawn continuously, never cut pieces.

finalBackgroundEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the edit target: an eight-frame character sprite sheet.
REPLACE THE CHECKERBOARD BACKGROUND WITH COMPLETELY SOLID BRIGHT GREEN #00FF00. Every pixel of the checkerboard must become green, including gaps between hair and hands, and inside the magnifying glass where present. This is a green-screen production export: solid pure green is REQUIRED. No transparency, no checkerboard, no texture, no folds, no shadows, no gradients.
Change the background ONLY. Keep all eight complete character drawings, their exact positions, expressions, gestures, dimensions, pale white clothing and colors completely unchanged. Keep the existing 4-column 2-row grid and exact framing. Do not redraw or move the heads, hands, feet, clothing or faces. White dress and pale skin remain fully opaque. Only the checkered backdrop becomes flat RGB(0,255,0).

revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: eight-frame animation sprite sheet, edit the supplied sheet.
Primary request: fix ONLY her wave so the open hand moves a short distance LEFT AND RIGHT across the image, with her PALM FACING THE VIEWER IN EVERY FRAME. Absolutely no wrist twist, no sideways/edge-on hand, no showing the back of her hand, no flipping. Five fingers and palm remain clearly visible at the SAME apparent width throughout. Think a gentle "hello" wave parallel to the screen, not turning a doorknob.
Animation: eight frames in the existing FOUR-column TWO-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Frame 1: neutral palm forward. Frame 2: palm forward and slightly to screen-left. Frame 3: palm forward at the leftmost point (about 12px left of neutral). Frame 4: palm forward back at neutral. Frame 5: palm forward slightly to screen-right. Frame 6: palm forward at the rightmost point (about 12px right of neutral). Frame 7: palm forward returning toward neutral. Frame 8: exactly frame 1. Fingers always upwards and the hand gently fanned, no finger curling; a tiny in-plane tilt is acceptable but NEVER rotate it out of the screen plane. Sleeve/wrist/elbow naturally drawn as one continuous arm with the very small lateral hand movement.
Invariants: Match the FIRST FRAME's complete character in every cell. Identical head, face, open eyes, smile, hair, neck, shoulders, left hand on her lap, torso, skirt folds, feet, silhouette, position and scale. No blinking or expression changes. Keep head perfectly still. Copy the first frame's coloring and shading consistently across the entire sheet: same skin tone, blonde hair, white dress, lavender shadows, outline color and opacity. NO brighter/darker/warmer/cooler frames. Only the raised hand and its connected forearm/sleeve gesture change.
Keep the current sheet dimensions and exactly equal grid cells. Entire seated figure in each cell; no text, labels, borders or extra elements. Preserve the perfectly flat solid RGB(0,255,0) green export background, including small gaps. NO checkerboard. This is a production green-screen sprite export.
Preserve the existing delicate anime artwork and Artoria's facial identity; no redesign, recoloring, head motion or body deformation.
